jobs.prompt: Fix T-8025 after its Opus review (which itself ran with the new structured output and produced a valid structured verdict, but the run was marked failed): (1) the anthropicSchema conversion drops maxLength/maxItems, so the model returned a finding 'issue' of 326 characters and validateReviewResult rejected the whole envelope, losing a valid verdict. Fix: for review results, structural problems still fail closed (missing reviews, empty reviews, bad ticket id, verdict not pass/fail, findings not an array, missing fields), but over-long strings are TRUNCATED to their limits (issue/fix 300, file 200, notes 4000) and a non-integer line becomes null, never failing the envelope; document why. (2) MEDIUM finding: isReadOnlyReviewJob must key ONLY on job.type === 'review' (drop the id-prefix and empty-outputs fallback) so non-review jobs are byte-for-byte unchanged; check that tools/security-review.mjs securityReviewManifest sets type 'review' (it does) and that acceptance review manifests built by tools/acceptance.mjs set type 'review' too if they go to API lanes (read tools/acceptance.mjs; if it builds API review jobs without type, add type: 'review' there and include tools/acceptance.mjs in your changes only if needed). (3) LOW finding: for review jobs, reject an envelope whose files or edits are non-empty (a review never writes). Tests in tests/review-structured-verdict.test.mjs: a review envelope with a 326-character issue and a long notes string is accepted with truncated text and the verdict kept; a job with id 'review-x' and type 'build' gets the normal schema and instructions (unchanged); a review envelope with a non-empty files array is rejected; the exact invalid envelope from the coordinator's run (evidence block) now validates. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test --test-timeout=60000 tests/review-structured-verdict.test.mjs tests/review-retry.test.mjs tests/review-recorder-lanes.test.mjs tests/anthropic-lane.test.mjs tests/lesson-40-eval.test.mjs` and `node tools/check-package.mjs`.
